display.purpose: The H1 wordmark TETUO41, once per page, full-bleed, sized to fill the viewport minus gutters.

lead.purpose: Single muted Japanese introduction sentence, max-width 36rem.

credits.purpose: Film-credit caps: billing block, nav chip, section heading, ticker.

shadows.name: pulse-ring
shadows.purpose: Verification chip's expanding white ring; the only box-shadow in the system, and it is transient.

motion.name: roll-in
motion.purpose: Credits roll-in on load: hero children rise and fade in sequence.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Ticker's seamless loop; each copy wider than the widest viewport; stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: grain-jitter
motion.purpose: Film-grain overlay position jitter at ~8fps; static under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Verification dot ring expansion; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

backdrops.name: film-grain
backdrops.value: fixed overlay, SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise 180px tile, opacity 0.055
backdrops.purpose: Cinematic grain across the whole viewport; atmosphere instead of elevation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: White-filled rectangular action; GitHub CTA. Hover empties to outline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.72rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgba(250,250,250,0.4)); background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #fafafa); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); color: var(--invert-fg, #050505); border-color: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #fafafa); border-color: var(--hairline-strong, rgba(250,250,250,0.4)); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); color: var(--invert-fg, #050505); border-color: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #fafafa); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Verified Chip
components.description: Signature identity chip: Keybase proof in credits microtype with pulsing white dot; inverts on hover.
components.html: Keybase で検証済み
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a6a6a6); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(250,250,250,0.16)); padding: 0.42rem 0.8rem; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--invert-fg, #050505); background: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); border-color: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); } .ds-pulse { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fg, #fafafa); animation: ds-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(250,250,250,0.35); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px transparent; } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; } }

components.name: Link List Row
components.description: Hairline index row that performs the title-card inversion on hover.
components.html: GitHubコード・プロジェクト→
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 0.5rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--fg, #fafafa); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(250,250,250,0.16)); transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--invert-bg, #fafafa); color: var(--invert-fg, #050505); } .ds-row-label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-row-note { color: var(--muted, #a6a6a6); font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-note { color: rgba(5,5,5,0.65); } .ds-row-arrow { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-4px, 4px); transition: opacity 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-row-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

components.name: Ticker
components.description: Signature motion: full-bleed marquee of verified facts in credits microtype, aria-hidden.
components.html: SIGNATURE VERIFIED · KEYBASE ED25519 · TETUO41.COM · TOKYO · HIROKI HATSUSHIKA · SIGNATURE VERIFIED · KEYBASE ED25519 · TETUO41.COM · TOKYO · HIROKI HATSUSHIKA ·
components.css: .ds-ticker { border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(250,250,250,0.16)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(250,250,250,0.16)); overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ticker-track { display: inline-flex; animation: ds-marquee 80s linear infinite; } .ds-ticker span { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a6a6a6); padding: 0.65rem 0; } @keyframes ds-marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ticker-track { animation: none; } }

components.name: Poster Title
components.description: The viewport-filling TETUO41 title card in Archivo Black, sized from measured ink width.
components.css: .ds-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Black', 'Archivo', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Noto Sans JP', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: max(3.2rem, min(24rem, calc((100vw - 4rem) / 5.02))); line-height: 0.85; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--fg, #fafafa); }

narrative.northStar: 黒いスクリーンの一枚のタイトルカード (A title card on a black screen)
narrative.overview: The page opens like an A24 film: a pure #050505 screen, a viewport-filling white TETUO41 in Archivo Black, and a billing block of tracked microtype underneath. This world is theatrical monochrome — no chromatic accent exists at all. Verification, focus, and hover all speak in white; the only pulsing element is the white dot of the Keybase proof. Everything rectangular. Interaction is one repeated gesture — the title-card inversion: link rows, buttons, and the nav chip flip from black-on-white to white-on-black on hover. Motion is cinematic and authored once: credits roll-in on load, a continuous marquee ticker of verified facts above the footer, and a film-grain overlay jittering at ~1Hz. prefers-reduced-motion stops every animation and reveals the hover arrows statically.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed black theme (color-scheme: dark); no light variant, pure monochrome
Viewport-filling Archivo Black poster title, sized to measured ink width (≈5.01em for TETUO41)
Title-card inversion as the single interaction gesture (160ms)
Continuous marquee ticker + film grain overlay; reduced-motion disables all animation
IBM Plex Mono reserved for the cryptographic fingerprint and keybase.txt

rules.name: The Black-Only Rule
rules.body: One fixed dark theme; no light variant, no accent hue, no tinted grays. If a design needs color to communicate, it is off-world.

rules.name: The Title-Card Rule
rules.body: Interaction = inversion. Hover flips background and text between Screen and Ink. Nothing changes hue because no hue exists.

rules.name: The Mono-as-Proof Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono appears only where cryptographic identity is spoken. Credits microtype is tracked Archivo caps, never mono.

rules.name: The Poster Rule
rules.body: Display type fills the viewport once, sized from measured ink width; it is never set at a comfortable reading size.

dos: Do keep the theme black-fixed; both theme-color metas and color-scheme say #050505 / dark.
Do make every interactive surface invert on hover — one gesture, system-wide, 160ms.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: no roll-in, no pulse, no marquee, no grain jitter; arrows visible.
Do set credits microtype as tracked Archivo caps (+0.14em), and size display type from measured ink.
Do keep the ticker and grain decorative: aria-hidden, no unique content, machine text stays in mono.
donts: Don't introduce any chromatic color, gradient, or a light theme; monochrome is the identity.
Don't round corners or add shadows at rest; rectangles and hairlines only.
Don't set body copy in mono, or decoration in mono — mono is proof text only.
Don't fabricate content; the page states only verified facts and confirmed links.
Don't slow the ticker or add second marquee-like motion; it is the one continuous movement.
